answer: A numbered dyed thread lowered into a karst spring pool is the proof. At dawn the holder lowers one thread and the keeper photographs the ripple rings its dye leaves with the date. Two verifiers return within 24 hours, lower a second thread beside it, and match the ripple pattern and number; a thread never lowered there or a duplicate number locks the account and burns its deposit. 100 fakes need 100 dyed threads and 100 trips to the spring.
